thread:
maria_marketing: Heads-up — we're prepping customer comms for the degraded API in eu-west. Need status page copy + timing for public post. Target: limit churn, route critical customers to dedicated channel. ASAP?

devin_sre: We have mitigations in flight but still investigating root cause. Recommend staged updates: 1) Investigating (post within 10m), 2) Mitigated (when error rate <1%), 3) Full recovery + short RCA within 24-48h.

sam_engineering: Agree. Also suggest including affected features (inference + embeddings) and a rough ETA window. Avoid promising exact times. Example copy variants below.

maria_marketing: Drop some copy candidates pls.

sam_engineering: "Investigating" candidate:
```
We're aware of elevated error rates for Redwood API in eu-west affecting model inference and embeddings. Our engineers are investigating. We'll post updates every 15 minutes or as we have new info.
```

devin_sre: "Mitigated" candidate:
```
The issue affecting inference throughput in eu-west has been mitigated. We're monitoring closely; traffic is being routed back to preferred nodes. If you notice issues, please open a support ticket or DM @alex_support.
```

olivia_sales: For enterprise customers — can we add a short email template explaining SLA steps and how we route failing requests to Dedicated? Also: routing for inbound leads: flag high-usage tenants in CS queue and notify AE.

alex_support: I'll prep the email template and set a high-priority flag in the support queue for impacted accounts. Recommend sending targeted emails 30-60m after "Mitigated" once we confirm stability.

maria_marketing: Timing decision: publish "Investigating" now, follow with "Mitigated" once <1% errors for 10 consecutive minutes. Post RCA summary in 24-48h. Also want a 1-line Console banner for immediate visibility.

devin_sre: Agreed. Note: don't mention rollbacks unless we perform one. Also include a single-line note about data impact — currently none observed.

opsbot: Incident created INC-2026-115 by devops at 1891234572.

maria_marketing: (drafts below)

maria_marketing: Console banner draft:
```
Degraded inference performance in eu-west — investigating. Real-time updates on https://status.redwood.ai. Prioritizing impacted customers.
```

maria_marketing: Customer email draft:
```
Subject: Redwood Service Alert — eu-west inference degraded

Hi <FirstName>,

We're currently investigating an issue causing degraded inference performance for services in the eu-west region. We're actively working to restore normal service and will follow up once mitigated. Immediate steps you can take: switch traffic to dedicated capacity or contact us at support@redwood.ai for priority assistance.

If you're an enterprise customer and would like a 1:1 ops call, reply to this email and we'll prioritize scheduling.

Thanks for your patience,
The Redwood Inference Team
```

olivia_sales: Fine — add the 1:1 ops call sentence and a short line offering post-incident credits for top-tier customers.

alex_support: Adding support link + CS queue flag now. Please include ticket link placeholder in the email before send so we can attach the ticket once created.

maria_marketing: Noted. I'll add the ticket link placeholder and send the Investigating post in ~3m. Will queue the targeted emails for send after Mitigated confirmation. Thanks all.
